queries_run: Deckers Brands tariff Vietnam Indonesia guidance 2026 earnings

findings.claim: FY2026 成品生產主要在越南與印尼，中國或任何其他單一國家不到 5%；關稅可能在有限通知下調整，公司揭露地理集中與關稅風險。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal year 2026, production of our finished goods was predominantly from Vietnam and Indonesia, while less than 5% was from China or any other individual country.

findings.claim: FY2026 毛利率 57.7%（前期 57.9%），主因國內商品增額關稅；IEEPA 關稅已被最高法院判無效，CBP 公告分階段退款流程，截至 2026-03-31 未認列任何退稅。
findings.excerpt: As of March 31, 2026, we have not recognized any amounts related to potential tariff refunds or other recoveries.

findings.claim: 毛利率下滑主因關稅，HOKA、UGG、Teva 皆受影響。
findings.excerpt: Gross margin decreased to 57.7% from 57.9%, compared to the prior period, primarily due to incremental tariffs on domestic goods and a slightly unfavorable channel mix

reg_tariff_export.note: Section 232 與出口管制搜尋未見 DECK 專屬揭露（搜尋結果的 232 內容為金屬類且無關 DECK）；10-Q（截至 2026-06-30）有 IEEPA 退款約 120,000 千美元之提及，未讀原文故未列 finding。

clues.claim: 10-Q（截至 2026-06-30）提及先前繳納 IEEPA 關稅總額及 2026 年 6 月公告的退款申請流程。
